bio: I am a master's student at the School of Artificial Intelligence, Beihang University. Previously, I interned with the RL Infrastructure group in Meituan's LongCat foundation model team.
My research focuses on reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for multimodal agent models. I am also passionate about exploring general-purpose computer use agents.
On this blog, I will share insights and research findings from research, engineering, and product perspectives.
